p.s: In the era of fast developing technology, enjoying life is becoming goal of life.
In my opinion, the young people enjoy life more than older people do.
Firstly, the older people have no enough time and spirits to enjoy their life.

In the competective society, the older people concentrate their attention on how to find a good job and so on, so their time and spirit is exhausted and even they want to enjoy life entirely it is not permitted by themselves.
In the contrast, that young people reletively have more time than older people makes them easier to enjoy life.
When the older people are busy to work, maybe the young people are watching movies or even traveling abroad.
Secondly, the young people meet a myriad of newly developed entertainment such as electric games and Internet.
As the developing of technology, it appears a lot of things that older people never met.
So if a older person have a CD-ROM of a new game or chat on the Internet, maybe he will not know what to do because in the time he is young he had never seen these things.
But the environment where the young people live forms them a broad accept ability to something completely new.
It is the young people who compete in the World Cyber Games competetion, it is also the young people who chat on the Internet and play net games.
So to the summary, young people enjoy life more than older people not only because they have enough time and spirits but they also meet and accept some new ways of enjoying life.
But this group of people may be older one day, so I think they should be more interested in enjoy life rather than geting tired as a older person.
